issues.description: Parameter ordering for the function create_controlled_single_qubit_gate is inconsistent across artifacts. The template signature defines the parameters as (num_qubits, target, control, gate_matrix) while the solution and the problem description expect (num_qubits, control, target, gate_matrix). This mismatch can confuse students about which argument is the control vs. the target qubit and lead to incorrect calls or implementations.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template function signature to match the problem statement and solution: def create_controlled_single_qubit_gate(num_qubits: int, control: int, target: int, gate_matrix: NDArray[np.complex128]) -> DD. Update any local references in the template to use the corrected parameter order.
